item.title: The M&M Gang
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): N/A

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: The SCP I have is about 5 plastic life sized figures representing the 5 members of the M&M franchise.

Central Narrative: The anomaly is 5 life sized plastic figurines representing the 5 M&M candy mascots. While nothing about it’s appearance or properties is anomalous itself when being recorded or photographed the figures are able to communicate with each other and Foundation personnel. They are able to feel pain to their physical bodies and have requested for foundation personnel to make the room colder, showing a physical feeling of temperature.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This article is mostly about how anomalous even normal objects can be. While I won’t go in depth, as last time I did the only posts were made by mods, I have more with this than just some general information.

Additional Notes: I would like to thank,forgot their name, for suggesting this idea.
